Class WaitingLine1<T>

java.lang.Object
components.waitingline.WaitingLineSecondary<T>
components.waitingline.WaitingLine1<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of entries
All Implemented Interfaces:
components.standard.Standard<WaitingLine<T>>, WaitingLine<T>, WaitingLineKernel<T>, Iterable<T>
public final class WaitingLine1<T> extends WaitingLineSecondary<T>
Waiting line represented by Sequence2L.
Author:
Baowen Liu
Convention:
rep != null; every entry of rep is non-null; no two entries of rep are equal according to equals
Correspondence:
this = the entries of rep, in their sequence order
